current_text: Start 2000
problem: SEAI documents 1995 inception; original start-year preservation claim is not satisfied for the family.
suggested_text_or_action: Use 1995 or document a narrower 2000 reporting phase; annotate original EEA record; assess early ramp changes.
evidence: [LIEN](https://www.seai.ie/blog/large-industry-network) (21 November 2018; opening section, paragraph beginning Throughout; accessed 2026-10-31)

current_text: ReHeat start 2008
problem: Official programme launched March 2007.
suggested_text_or_action: Propose 2007 after confirming family identity; retain quoted EEA date and explain discrepancy.
evidence: [RENEW2012](https://www.seai.ie/sites/default/files/publications/Renewable-Energy-in-Ireland-2012.pdf) (Appendix A2.2.8; A2.3.3; A2.3.8; accessed 2026-10-31)

current_text: Combined SEEEP/EERF/Better Energy Workplaces ends 2010
problem: Named component operated in 2011; combined family period cannot establish that all components expired in 2010.
suggested_text_or_action: Separate component chronology in annotation; approve a justified family end or narrower name before recalculation.
evidence: [EFF2011](https://www.seai.ie/sites/default/files/publications/Economic-Analysis-of-Residential-and-Small-Business-Energy-Efficiency-Improvements.pdf) (Summary of main results; Introduction and non-technical summary, printed p.9; accessed 2026-10-31)

current_text: Solar pilot start 2019
problem: Domestic PV pilot introduced July 2018; source description also overextends technology and recipient scope.
suggested_text_or_action: Confirm this is domestic PV pilot, then use 2018; quote source and add scope correction separately.
evidence: [SOLAR](https://data.oireachtas.ie/ie/oireachtas/debateRecord/dail/2019-09-24/writtens/mul%40/main.pdf) (Written answers, Questions 420 and 430; accessed 2026-10-31)

current_text: Smart meter rollout start 2021
problem: Installer describes rollout from late 2019.
suggested_text_or_action: Use 2019 for installation rollout or explicitly rename 2021 service-activation/modelled-effect phase.
evidence: [SMART](https://www.esbnetworks.ie/customer-support/customer-support-queries/meter-reading/smart-meters) (Section 1: About the Programme; accessed 2026-10-31)

current_text: Non-transport fuels followed ... May 2010; other fuels ... May 2012
problem: Includes solid fuels in wording even though their introduction was later.
suggested_text_or_action: Name liquid heating fuels and natural gas for 2010/2012; separately state solid fuels from May 2013 at EUR10, rising to EUR20 in May 2014.
evidence: [CARBON](https://www.revenue.ie/en/tax-professionals/tdm/excise/excise-duty-rates/energy-excise-duty-rates.pdf) (Sections 1–3, pp.3–7; Appendix, previous mineral-oil rates; accessed 2026-10-31); [CARBON2010](https://www.seai.ie/sites/default/files/publications/Renewable-Energy-in-Ireland-2013-Update.pdf) (Carbon tax passage and Budget 2010 footnote; accessed 2026-10-31)

current_text: 2021–2023 milestones show only May non-transport changes
problem: Motor-fuel rate steps are omitted, leaving an uneven chronology.
suggested_text_or_action: Add fuel-specific October changes and distinguish the historical 2020 legislated path from current law. State the final legislated 2030 step separately; do not extend annual values beyond 2023.
evidence: [CARBON](https://www.revenue.ie/en/tax-professionals/tdm/excise/excise-duty-rates/energy-excise-duty-rates.pdf) (Sections 1–3, pp.3–7; Appendix, previous mineral-oil rates; accessed 2026-10-31)

page: Every open-ended profile; timeline/category status definitions
current_text: in force since [start_year]
problem: Proxy starts and residual bundles are presented as legal in-force dates, contradicting start_year_basis.
suggested_text_or_action: Recorded from [year] on a [legal/source-report/OECD-proxy] basis. For bundles: earliest recorded member start. Define Active as active under the selected dating convention.
evidence: [OECD](https://www.oecd.org/en/data/insights/data-explainers/2025/04/the-climate-actions-and-policies-measurement-framework-capmf.html) (Sections 1–3; calculation and interpretation of stringency; accessed 2026-10-31); [LABELCAR](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/ALL/?uri=CELEX%3A31999L0094) (Title; Articles 3 and 12; OJ L12, 18 January 2000; accessed 2026-10-31)

current_text: About this policy: [source description]
problem: Original EEA records are displayed as unqualified editorial prose, not explicitly attributed quotations.
suggested_text_or_action: Label Source description — EEA PaM [ID], preserve wording, and place auditor annotation separately. Inaccurate source text must not be silently rewritten.
evidence: Release data and independently recomputed audit outputs; accessed 2026-10-31

current_text: Frameworks, portfolios and residual bundles repeat other rows
problem: Residual members are not separate core rows; blanket duplication statement is inaccurate.
suggested_text_or_action: Frameworks and portfolios may overlap other series. Residual members are omitted from the core panel; do not add members back to their bundle.
evidence: Release data and independently recomputed audit outputs; accessed 2026-10-31

current_text: reach 90% of each sector's reported savings
problem: Zero-denominator LULUCF cannot reach an assessable 90% share; largest refers to reported estimates, not verified impact.
suggested_text_or_action: Where positive eligible estimates exist, select ranked measures until at least 90% of that reported total is covered. LULUCF is not assessable; anchors and residuals retain other eligible measures.
evidence: Release data and independently recomputed audit outputs; accessed 2026-10-31

current_text: Top-impact
problem: Implies proven mitigation effectiveness; ranking uses retrospective reported estimates.
suggested_text_or_action: Selected by reported savings / Materiality selection. Keep the existing retrospective caveat.
evidence: Release data and independently recomputed audit outputs; accessed 2026-10-31

current_text: Active core series; profiles say assumed active years
problem: Code includes post-expiry rows; loader counts all non-pre-implementation assumed years.
suggested_text_or_action: Label Core series after recorded start (including post-expiry effects); profiles: years using assumed timing after start. No score change required.
evidence: Release data and independently recomputed audit outputs; accessed 2026-10-31

current_text: Watch the lines darken as policies take effect
problem: Darker cells may reflect assumed ramps or contextual OECD changes, not observed effects.
suggested_text_or_action: Darker cells indicate higher values of the policy-intensity proxy, based on OECD scores or assumed timing.
evidence: [OECD](https://www.oecd.org/en/data/insights/data-explainers/2025/04/the-climate-actions-and-policies-measurement-framework-capmf.html) (Sections 1–3; calculation and interpretation of stringency; accessed 2026-10-31)

current_text: Assumed years are hatched
problem: Renderer excludes residual rows and pre-start zeros from hatching; broad promise is incomplete.
suggested_text_or_action: Hatching marks assumed values for non-residual series after their recorded start. Residual means may combine assumed and OECD-derived member values.
evidence: Release data and independently recomputed audit outputs; accessed 2026-10-31

current_text: Level 2: sector by market-based or other instruments
problem: Level 2 also includes cross-sectoral/international modules; numeric score is relative.
suggested_text_or_action: Level 2 comprises 15 modules, including sector/instrument groups and cross-sectoral and international categories. Explain 10 as highest scored group, not adequacy or best practice.
evidence: [OECD](https://www.oecd.org/en/data/insights/data-explainers/2025/04/the-climate-actions-and-policies-measurement-framework-capmf.html) (Sections 1–3; calculation and interpretation of stringency; accessed 2026-10-31)

current_text: Enacted 23 July
problem: No commencement milestone alongside enactment. Annual start remains correct.
suggested_text_or_action: Add 7 September 2021 commencement, citing S.I.468/2021 article 2.
evidence: [COMMENCE](https://www.irishstatutebook.ie/eli/2021/si/468/made/en/print) (Article 2; accessed 2026-10-31)

current_text: maximum emissions for each sector of the economy
problem: 2022 agreement did not finalise all sectors, notably LULUCF.
suggested_text_or_action: Maximum emissions for specified sectors; LULUCF ceiling was deferred in the July 2022 agreement.
evidence: [CEILINGS](https://www.gov.ie/en/department-of-the-taoiseach/press-releases/government-announces-sectoral-emissions-ceilings-setting-ireland-on-a-pathway-to-turn-the-tide-on-climate-change/) (28 July 2022; Further information; Notes; accessed 2026-10-31)

current_text: 2011 motor standard; tightened in later stages
problem: Successor regulation and application date missing from milestones.
suggested_text_or_action: Add Regulation 2019/1781 applying from 1 July 2021 and explain later staged requirements; score remains source-derived.
evidence: [MOTORS](https://energy-efficient-products.ec.europa.eu/product-list/electric-motors_en) (Ecodesign requirements; accessed 2026-10-31)

current_text: The impact of the European Union Emissions Trading Scheme
problem: Article title omits On Regulated Firms.
suggested_text_or_action: Restore complete title: The Impact of the European Union Emissions Trading Scheme on Regulated Firms: What Is the Evidence after Ten Years?
evidence: [MARTIN](https://www.journals.uchicago.edu/doi/10.1093/reep/rev016) (Title; volume/issue/pages; accessed 2026-10-31)

current_text: How much of the sector the policy legally covers
problem: Scope score also classifies voluntary programmes and recipient segments; legal coverage is too narrow.
suggested_text_or_action: Researcher-assigned ordinal scope of the instrument or programme, covering eligible activities, technologies or recipients; not a measured emissions share.
evidence: Release data and independently recomputed audit outputs; accessed 2026-10-31
